record.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated WorldSim style05 game crop sprite on genuine transparent alpha. References ground and scene are ONLY ink/earth-wash/lighting anchors, berry bush controls quiet game-scale line/wash, Route I controls the standing front THREE-QUARTER camera about 20 degrees down (not overhead). Fine controlled warm dark-brown ink contours, outer-to-secondary weight 2:1, broad restrained sage/olive green wash, clear darker lower/right shadow wash, bright upper-left daylight. Selective detail only: 3 leaf-vein accents per foliage clump and one group of 3 parallel / shadow hatches, no dense crosshatching, no photoreal/3D/pixel art. Strong botanical silhouette readable at 64px world tile. ENTIRE plant(s) centered with generous transparent margin; all spaces alpha-zero; no soil island, ground patch, cast shadow puddle, pot, backdrop, labels, text, border, haze or halo. No modern or metal fittings. Large source for uniform downsample. SUBJECT: Harvested PEA field stage: five very short cut light-ochre thin stems, few dull olive paired rounded lower leaflets left attached, same shallow staggered five-stem patch. No pods, no flowers, no tall tendrils or tools.8px game height, cluster<=34px wide. Tops and upper-left surfaces pale tan/sage, lower-right sides DARK muted olive/brown wash; clear controlled brown outlines. No roots/soil. TRANSPARENCY CRITICAL: outside the actual plant, stakes and rope, every pixel must have ALPHA ZERO. No colored haze, aura, glow, diffuse wash, backdrop, ground or soft shadow anywhere. The watercolor texture exists only INSIDE opaque plant surfaces. No outer blur. Clean cutout with a fine antialias edge only.
